component: worker executor batch request completeness validation

integrityContract.acceptedCondition: buildFailures.isEmpty && gatedRouteCount == eligibleRouteCount && eligibleRouteCount == requests.length && requests.length > 0
integrityContract.oldRisk: executorBatchEligibleRouteCount was derived only from successfully built requests, so a gated profitable route could be silently omitted while the remaining partial batch still passed its count check

rollbackPoint: revert Result-based executor request collection, batch failure evidence fields, and shared completeness validator

rustChanges.persistencePolicy: No long-term review/submission/broadcast schema expansion; completeness evidence is regenerated in the current worker payload.

routeClassification.Err(reason): route passed execution gates but executor request construction failed; block the complete batch
routeClassification.Ok(None): route is not profitable or did not pass all execution gates; exclude it from the gated set
routeClassification.Ok(Some(request)): route passed all execution gates and produced a bounded request

title: P0-8 batch request completeness fail-closed
